name: GlobeXAI — Production Trade Automation OS (Real ML, RAG & PostgreSQL)

parameters.content:
## 🌐 GLOBEX AI — PRODUCTION TRADE AUTOMATION & ML ORCHESTRATION

**100% REAL ML & DL MODELS INTEGRATED:**
1. 🏷️ **HS Classification Engine** (`POST /predict/hs-code`)
2. 📈 **Quantile XGBoost Residual Demand Forecaster** (`POST /predict/market-opportunity`)
   - Generates point estimates, 80% P10–P90 confidence bands, and exact TreeSHAP attributions.
3. 🚨 **Unsupervised IsolationForest Anomaly Engine** (`POST /api/trade-anomaly/predict`)
   - Unsupervised outlier scoring + 26-year peer-price Z-score distribution.
4. 🤝 **Counterparty Matching & Sanctions Screening** (`POST /predict/counterparty-match`)
   - 31,629 OFAC, UN, UK, EU entity screening.
5. 📜 **Compliance RAG Retriever** (`POST /compliance/rag-analyze`)
   - Grounded bilateral treaty retrieval (CEPA, ECTA) + World Bank WITS TRAINS tariff schedules.
6. 📑 **Multi-Model Trade Dossier Synthesis** (`POST /api/v1/trade/generate-report`)
   - Synthesizes all model outputs into an Executive Trade Dossier.
7. 📄 **Document OCR Extraction** (`POST /documents/ocr-extract`)
